messages.text: BL-1639 🎵 in progress — Bedtime stops every babysitterd its own verify would count: finish-shift's babysitterd stop, its verify and kill_all_swarm's babysitterd signal read one root-scoped process census, so a second babysitterd launched from an operator-local copy is signalled at bedtime instead of surviving it as REFUSE rc=1 and an orphan (2026-09-18 16:00Z; babysitterd named in 3 of the last 7 recorded bedtime refusals)
